title: Strongholds
description: A lesson on understanding sin, overcoming strongholds, and experiencing freedom through God’s forgiveness and truth.

cards.heading: Sharing Your Time with God
cards.scriptureText: The unfolding of your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.
cards.body: Share what you have been hearing from God. Encourage your disciple to share what they have learned, especially through reading the Gospel of Mark.
cards.question: What has God been teaching you recently?

cards.heading: Reviewing God’s Promises
cards.scriptureText: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us.
cards.body: Review key verses together. These truths remind us of God’s promises, especially His forgiveness and faithfulness.
cards.question: What do these verses teach you about God’s character?

cards.heading: Understanding Sin
cards.scriptureText: For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.
cards.body: Sin separates us from God and affects our thoughts, actions, and relationship with Him. Recognizing sin is the first step toward freedom.
cards.question: What does sin mean to you personally?

cards.heading: Responding to Sin
cards.scriptureText: Against you, you only, have I sinned.
cards.body: When we sin, we must confess it to God, turn away from it, accept His forgiveness, and thank Him for His grace. God is always ready to forgive those who come to Him sincerely.
cards.question: What steps can you take when you recognize sin in your life?

cards.heading: God’s Forgiveness Brings Freedom
cards.scriptureText: He is faithful and just and will forgive us and purify us from all unrighteousness.
cards.body: God not only forgives but also cleanses us. His forgiveness removes guilt and restores our relationship with Him.
cards.question: Do you believe God has fully forgiven you? Why or why not?

cards.heading: What Is a Stronghold?
cards.scriptureText: The weapons we fight with... have divine power to demolish strongholds.
cards.body: A stronghold is a pattern of sin, wrong thinking, or habit that controls a person’s life. Everyone struggles with areas that require ongoing victory.
cards.question: What patterns or struggles do you find difficult to overcome?

cards.heading: Freedom from Strongholds
cards.scriptureText: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
cards.body: Freedom begins by surrendering to God, rejecting lies, and choosing truth. Victory may take time, but God gives strength to overcome.
cards.question: What truth from God can help you overcome your struggles?

cards.heading: Walking in Freedom
cards.scriptureText: Walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.
cards.body: Stay close to God through prayer, His Word, and fellowship with other believers. Support from others helps strengthen your journey toward freedom.
cards.question: Who can help support you in your spiritual growth?

cards.heading: God’s Love and Acceptance
cards.scriptureText: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
cards.body: God understands your struggles and still loves you completely. His grace is greater than your failures, and He accepts you as His child.
cards.question: How does knowing God accepts you change the way you see yourself?

cards.heading: Next Steps
cards.scriptureText: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live for themselves but for him.
cards.body: Set your next meeting and continue walking closely with God. Take small, consistent steps toward freedom and growth.
cards.question: What step will you take this week toward freedom from a stronghold?
